Classical/Columns/parthenon_column.obj.name: Parthenon Doric Column
Classical/Columns/parthenon_column.obj.description: A Doric column at the Parthenon's proportions: a fluted, tapering shaft about 1.9 m across at the base, a curved echinus and a square abacus; 10.17 m tall.

provenance.author: Shaft: PantheraLeo1359531 (Wikimedia Commons); capital: Reviera contributors
provenance.modified: Shaft reduced from 494,392 to 20,000 triangles (tools/decimate_stl.py) and scaled by 0.7; echinus and abacus added (tools/make_parthenon_column.py).
